xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4486: New conversation: keep one-click quick create, add a split-button dialog for model, effort, context, skills and linked issue

plan.title: New conversation: keep one-click quick create, add a split-button dialog for model, effort, context, skills and linked issue
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The issue's own acceptance criteria bind the dialog to backend behavior ('the row records each one', 'a per-conversation skill override survives resume'); the conversation skill layer has no operator-visible surface without the dialog, and the dialog cannot satisfy its ACs without the layer. Doc files each count as a subsystem under the surface lint, and the docs item is required. Work is decomposed into 14 vertical items with explicit DAG edges instead of sibling issues.

narratives.Problem: The Command Deck sidebar sets new-conversation options in place: sticky 'No context' and 'Skip CLAUDE.md' checkboxes persist in localStorage and silently carry into the next conversation, and there is no UI for an effort default with its source, a linked issue, or per-conversation skills. PAN-3942 shipped global/project/issue skill layers but no conversation layer.
narratives.Proposal: Turn the sidebar + into a split button: main click stays quick create (stored model/harness/effort, default context); a caret menu item and a command-palette action open a store-driven 'New conversation with options' dialog (project + working directory, model + harness, effort with resolved default and source, context opt-outs, per-conversation skill Inherit/On/Off, linked issue, first message) whose choices apply to that conversation only. Backend: a conversation skill layer stored on the row (conversations.skill_overrides) and applied by `pan skills launch-settings --conversation <tmuxSession>` on every launch; POST /api/conversations accepts skillOverrides and a cwd inside the chosen project; new GET /api/effort/default. The two checkboxes leave the sidebar.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Template conversations or curated skill sets (PAN-1357)
- Changing the Home composer or the Stage PaneBar 'New conversation' item
- Conversation-level pack toggles (conversation values are per-skill only)
- Editing a live conversation's skill overrides after creation, or any PUT door for a conversation level; SkillOverrideLevel must not gain 'conversation'
- Removing the orphaned overdeck.commandDeck.newConversationContext localStorage key
- Changing the sidebar model/harness/effort pickers or quick create beyond dropping the context opt-outs
- Applying conversation skill overrides to harnesses other than claude-code and codex
- A server-side issue search endpoint
- Changing the fork/handoff door's cwd rules
- Raising any file-size allowlist row

autoDecisions.summary: Conversation skill overrides are stored on the row and read by the launch-settings step via a new --conversation <tmuxSession> flag emitted from launcher-lines.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: Every relaunch (create, resume, restart-all, fork) regenerates the launcher with spawnMode 'conversation' and managedStateKey, so the override survives resume with zero lines added to conversation-runtime.ts, which sits exactly at its 1252-line cap; an env var could leak into child launches.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not widen SkillOverrideLevel; add a separate conversation map and a 'conversation' source
autoDecisions.rationale: The PUT /api/skills/overrides store door keys off SkillOverrideLevel and cannot persist a conversation level; conversation values are set only at creation.

autoDecisions.summary: Working directory accepted only with projectKey, validated by validateCwdContainment plus realpath containment in the project path; primary checkout allowed
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the fork door's existing containment helper; the project root is today's default create cwd, so banning the primary checkout would break the default.

autoDecisions.summary: The dialog always sends effort (resolved default when untouched) when the model supports effort
autoDecisions.rationale: Satisfies 'the row records each one' and matches PAN-4254's clamped-effort persistence.

autoDecisions.summary: Dialog host mounted in main.tsx via a zustand store; opens the created conversation through /conv/<id>
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows the documented dialog-host convention (LinkPullRequestDialogHost) so the palette can open it anywhere; a window-event fallback is specified as an implementation checkpoint.

autoDecisions.summary: Issue picker filters the dashboard store's issues client-side
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest change; the palette already lists issues from the same store, and no search endpoint is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep a single issue with plan.metadata.sizeJustification rather than splitting into sibling issues
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's ACs require the backend layer and dialog together; the backend slice has no operator-visible surface alone.

autoDecisions.summary: Quick create stops sending context opt-outs; the old localStorage key is left orphaned
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue moves both checkboxes into the dialog and says quick create uses default context; deleting the key adds lines to a capped file for no behavior gain.
getSupervisedConversationByTmuxSession prefers the sibling, so without the copy a /clear would drop the conversation's skill overrides (and today already drops bareContext).
